svg.aria-label: Console clock error over a week
svg.title: Console clock error over a week
svg.desc: The clock error falls steadily through each day and rises just after midnight by the console's own jump, a sawtooth. For the first day the jump is the one the console came with, and the sawtooth climbs. From the second, the driver rewrites the jump each night it needs to, and the sawtooth stays in the band around center. The clock is never set.
svg.text: Console clock error, seconds (positive is fast)
shaded: the band the driver keeps the clock in, the centered sawtooth give or take 0.19 s
